text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Mejiro Ardan's Debut approaching, two 
Umamusume of the same generation who are 
her friends were diligently pushing each 
other to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their names were Sakura Chiyono O and 
Yaeno Muteki. Both cheered on Mejiro 
Ardan's debut, looking forward to the day 
they would run together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro Ardan matter-of-factly 
told the two that due to her frail body, 
she couldn't promise she would be able to 
run alongside them in the actual race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki 
were certain that they and Mejiro Ardan 
would inevitably cross paths in future 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the mingling of their respective 
feelings, Mejiro Ardan's debut race was 
about to begin...
